result:
I saved the Q3 2025 answers to `answer.json`. Before calculating Q3, I ran the same method on Q2 and it reproduced all 10 reference values exactly.

**Q3 results**
| Question | Answer |
|---|---|
| a. Segment with the highest net sales | `smb`, 336,387,554원 |
| b. Customers with a paid order | 247 |
| c. Category with the highest net sales | `hw`, 306,694,527원 |
| d. Month with the highest net sales | 2025-08 |
| e. Customer with the largest refund total | u168@ex.com |
| f. Customers with 2 or more paid orders | 229 |
| g. Average net sales per order | 686,876원 |
| h. Growth from August to September | -8.7% |

**Data adjustments needed to match the Q2 reference**
- **Dates in Korean time:** `ordered_at` is stored in UTC (it ends in `Z`). I added 9 hours to put orders in Korean time before splitting by quarter and month. Without this shift, the Q2 net sales, best month and growth rate don't match.
- **One customer per email:** 300 customer IDs share only 250 distinct emails, so the same person appears under more than one ID. I counted customers by email, which brings Q2 to the reference values of 235 for b and 188 for f.
- **Segment labels cleaned:** some segment values had stray spaces or capitals (`" consumer"`, `"Enterprise "`, `"SMB"`). I trimmed and lowercased them before grouping, and each order's segment comes from the customer ID that placed it.

STATUS: DONE
